title: Your AI Went to Work
script: It is 2032. You are late for work. Nobody noticed. Your AI joined the morning meeting, answered three messages, and repaired the spreadsheet you forgot about. On the train, you read a summary of a conversation you never had. Your manager says the presentation was excellent. You say thanks, then open the file for the first time. At five, HR asks a new question: which hours were yours, and which belonged to the agent? The work got done. But if the AI did your shift, who gets paid?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Your AI joins a meeting, fixes a spreadsheet and drafts replies; HR asks who did the work.
whyNow: A present capability creates a plausible human decision; this is a scenario, not a forecast.
viewerGoal: Consider the human consequence and choose a boundary.
hooks: It is 2032. You are late for work. Nobody noticed.
You missed the meeting. Your AI did not.
Your manager loved work you have not opened yet.
strongestHook: It is 2032. You are late for work. Nobody noticed.
directorBrief: Direct this as a human story about Your AI joins a meeting, fixes a spreadsheet and drafts replies; HR asks who did the work. Emotional movement: surprise → fairness. Open with a recognisable person or object, introduce one consequence, then leave the final choice unresolved. Fictional dates and interfaces are scenario details. Facts must be separately sourced; use a small persistent POSSIBLE FUTURE label, never a news-like breaking banner.
effort: 60–120 minutes asset production and edit; no audio included.
protocol: Produce original story assets, review factual grounding, verify every future claim is conditional or explicitly fictional, then inspect continuity and safe zones. No real-world experiment outcome is claimed.
evidenceRequirements: Verify real agent capabilities; employee proxy and HR events are fiction.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Your AI Clocked In” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: The work got done. But if the AI did your shift, who gets paid?
instagramCaption: Your AI Went to Work. A possible future, grounded in present technology. The dates and scenario are fictional. The work got done. But if the AI did your shift, who gets paid?
tiktokCaption: Your AI Went to Work. WHO GETS PAID? Speculative scenario.
music: Original/licensed minimal ambient pulse; warmer for education/relationships, quiet tension for identity. 88–104 BPM, VO comfortably above music.
recordings: Only source-page capture for grounded factual beats; all scenario environments are original fictional assets.
screenshots: Dated primary-source captures and a contact sheet proving character/object continuity.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Bedroom, office, task log, meeting UI, employee badge.
